title: Apple unveils iOS 27, highlighting performance and design improvements, including smoother system animations, says iPhone 11 and newer phones will be supported (Jay Peters/The Verge)
summary: Jay Peters / The Verge: Apple unveils iOS 27, highlighting performance and design improvements, including smoother system animations, says iPhone 11 and newer phones will be supported — Your iPhone is getting new features. Your iPhone is getting new features. … Apple announced its next major iOS update, iOS 27, at WWDC 2026 on Monday.
